contexts.text: The Lord gives man food... which is states of tranquillity and peace... at intervals. Signified.
He thus enjoys... also external tranquillity and delight. Signified.
As he becomes celestial... tranquillity ensues. This tranquillity is signified by rain, and mist.... This tranquillity which is of peace produces what are called the shrub, and the herb... AC 93.
Under Peace, see this reference. AC 1275. AC 2183:2. AC 3696. AC 6469. AC 8722.
The Angels are in such a proprium, and at the same time in the greatest peace and tranquillity.
To sit involves something of tranquillity.
He lay in that place = the tranquillity of the state.
Peace in externals is called tranquillity.

Every man is in a state of tranquillity in the beginning of his life, or in infancy; but in proportion as he advances in life... he removes himself from that state, because he gives himself up to worldly cares and the derivative anxieties...
So with the new life... in the beginning he is in a state of tranquillity; but, as he passes into the new life, he passes into an untranquil state. Explained.
A Spirit seen who was in a state of tranquillity. Described... They relate to the longitudinal sinus.
They passed the night (together) = tranquillity... For they who have been conjoined as to good and truth are in tranquillity, and in peace.

The further they removed from internal sensuous things... the more tranquil and quiet it became with them... The reason was that when the external sensuous are in their fallacies... they have what is tranquil; but when such things are taken away from them... they have what is untranquil.
Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem = the interior truths of faith, which are those of tranquillity.

So long as they are in exterior truths, and especially when they are coming from exterior into interior ones, the state is untranquil; for then there are combats of temptations. This is here represented by Jacob, in that after having been in fear and anxiety on account of Esau, he has now come into a state of tranquillity.
When man is, in faith and life, in interior truths, he is in... a state of tranquillity; and then looks at exterior things as one who looks from a high hill upon the sea in tumult.
Spirits, after being troubled, are let into a tranquil and delightful state.
There is no tranquillity until the time when truths from good are replaced in their order.
Perception given that they are in tranquillity. Signified, Explained.
Their wise men said, that when the mind is withdrawn from sensuous things, it comes... into a tranquil state.
Under Shiloh, see this reference.
The blessedness of the affections (is felt only) as a tranquil state arising from contentment of mind.
The Spirits of Jupiter wish to inspire the inhabitants of their Earth with tranquillity and delight of heart.
The Spirits of our Earth do not love tranquillity as do those of Jupiter.
Orderly arrangement is effected in tranquillity.
This is not peace; but is the delight and tranquillity of cupidities.
The mind hereby tranquillises itself.
And [all] became tranquil and serene.
Tranquil spheres. Explained.
The prior atmosphere acts tranquilly. SE 1176:end. SE 2089.
All things were in a state of tranquillity.
I spoke with some in that tranquillity, tranquilly.
Suddenly, all became tranquil.
There was a quietude among the Spirits, as if they did not know where I was.
They were from Societies where there is tranquillity; for I perceived a tranquillity of mind...
Such disturb all tranquillity of mind with others.
This is their [state of] tranquillity.
There was a tranquillity there, because they wore in order.
In tranquil quiets () = in the delights of good and the pleasantnesses of truth.
When, the Divine inflows moderately, there is everywhere a tranquillity and serenity.
There was a great calm (). Explained.
As the Lord is then present in the good of love, there is effected tranquillity of mind.
Tranquillity of quiet () = security, and no anxiety on account of any evil.
